description: This file defines a UI class for a Qt-based application, generated by the Qt Designer UI compiler. It contains code for setting up the user interface components of a 'Time converters' window, including labels, buttons, a table widget, and a text editor for editing Python code. The UI elements are related to managing 'converters', with functionalities for adding, modifying, deleting, loading, and saving converter configurations.

classes.name: Ui_converters
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the setup of the converters UI, including layout and widget initialization, for a Qt application.

methods.name: setupUi(self, converters)
methods.description: Initializes and arranges all UI components within the given 'converters' widget/container.

methods.name: retranslateUi(self, converters)
methods.description: Sets the text labels and titles for UI components, enabling easy translation/localization.
